item.title: Iranian President Pezeshkian meets incoming Basij commander
item.description:
Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian met with Hossein Taeb, who was appointed commander of the Basij organization of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC). During the meeting, Pezeshkian congratulated Taeb on his appointment.
Taeb, who previously served as head of the IRGC's Intelligence Organization and as commander of the Basij during the suppression of the 2009 protests, was appointed to the position by order of Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei, following the death of the previous commander, Gholam-Reza Soleimani.

item.title: Family of missing women in Vienna: Nationalistic motive cannot be ruled out
item.description:
The family of Mali and Liel Yahalomi, the Israeli mother and daughter missing in Vienna, is sharply criticizing recent publications and briefings by police and investigative officials.
In an official statement, the family clarified: "We view with utmost severity the briefings circulated in recent hours, which create the public impression that a conclusion has already been established regarding the circumstances of Mali and Liel's disappearance. The family possesses information that fundamentally contradicts several of the claims raised in these reports."
According to the family, the information provided to them by the police shows no unusual activity on the bank accounts of either woman: "We unequivocally clarify that at this stage, there is no basis for ruling out the possibility of a nationalistically motivated terrorist incident."

item.title: Netanyahu orders immediate dispatch of aid delegation to Colombia
item.description:
Following a request from Colombian President Abelardo de la Espriella, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on Wednesday evening ordered the immediate dispatch of an aid delegation to Colombia following the earthquake disaster that struck the country.
"The State of Israel shares in the grief of the families of those killed in the disaster and will provide full assistance to the Republic of Colombia," said the Prime Minister's Office.
